items.text: Some pairs fit together, such as design plus code, finance plus data, or teaching plus content.
Who pays you Employers and clients who need the mix.

blocks.heading: Cheap Four-Week Test on Both Options
rows: Decide by comparing in your head
Weak
You are guessing how the work feels and what it pays.
Decide with a four-week test of each option
Strong
You see the work, the proof needed and the response from people in the field.
Decide by asking only family or friends
Mixed
Decide by picking the option with the lowest regret if wrong
Good tie-breaker
It protects money, time and options when evidence is close.

blocks.heading: Common Mix-Ups to Avoid
rows: Treating the choice as permanent
Most careers allow a switch with a new skill.
Plan for review points instead.
Comparing job titles
The daily work differs from the title.
Test the tasks.
Choosing by the highest posted pay
Pay depends on proof and level.
Compare the full path.

blocks.heading: Choosing Between Two Paths
rows: Notices read
Ten, mostly asking for content, ads and reporting
Ten, mostly asking for Excel, SQL and dashboards
Small task
Plan and run a tiny ad test for a local shop
Answer one sales question from a public dataset
How the work felt
Fast, creative, results visible in days
Slow, careful, satisfying when the answer is clear
Proof built
A campaign summary
A dashboard and write-up
Cost of being wrong
Low, skills carry into sales and content
Low, skills carry into finance and operations
